metadata.title: Curvature, second variation and Jacobi fields in elastic diffeology
metadata.abstract: We develop curvature theory on Blohmann's elastic diffeological spaces. We introduce curvature-tensorial connections, whose curvature factors uniquely through $T_3M$, and show that this property holds on finite-dimensional manifolds and is preserved on mapping spaces. Using a plotwise commutator identity and the elasticity axioms, we establish the classical curvature symmetries for curvature-tensorial Levi-Civita connections. We define sectional curvature and a curvature form on the algebraic exterior square, and demonstrate an obstruction to the usual Ricci trace construction: on $C^\infty(S^1,S^2)$, the relevant curvature endomorphism extends boundedly to the $L^2$ completion but is not trace class. We prove the second variation formula, identify the energy Hessian with the index form, and characterize its null space. Under additional hypotheses, we establish existence and uniqueness of Jacobi fields with prescribed initial data. Finally, non-positive sectional curvature excludes conjugate points, while a negative index direction obstructs length minimization.

analysis.workSummary: 在弹性微分空间中构造曲率、二阶变分及 Jacobi 场框架，并展示映射空间上 Ricci 迹可能不存在的障碍。
techniques: 弹性微分空间与三重切丛
analysis.breakthrough: 将有限维黎曼几何的若干二阶结构推广到该框架，并以 C∞(S¹,S²) 的 L² 延拓说明有界曲率算子未必可取迹。
analysis.limitations: Jacobi 场的存在唯一性有额外假设；不能由曲率框架自动推断无限维 Ricci 张量存在。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 明确披露 ChatGPT 与 Claude 用于语言编辑、检查证明和讨论材料组织，最终结果与证明由作者验证。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.29360v1 · PDF 第 4 页 Declaration of generative AI in the writing process

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。明确披露 ChatGPT 与 Claude 用于语言编辑、检查证明和讨论材料组织，最终结果与证明由作者验证。

analysis.priorityReason: 无限维几何的结构建设及明确的适用边界。
